meta.title: Fifth wrong password locks the username for 15 minutes and says how long
steps: Submit the QA-USER with 5 wrong passwords in the app
Submit again with the RIGHT password
Call the API log-in with the right password
Log in as a different QA user through the API
expected: Attempts 1–4 show 'Username or password is wrong' — UI tree
After the 5th wrong password the next attempt (right password) shows 'Too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes.' (14 or 15 minutes) — UI tree + screenshot
API log-in for the locked name → 423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED with retryAfterSec between 840 and 900 — API response
A different username is not locked (API 200) — API response

1.observed: first four messages: ['Username or password is wrong', 'Username or password is wrong', 'Username or password is wrong', 'Username or password is wrong']; fifth: 'Too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes.'

2.observed: message='Too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes.'
